stability: Anything not listed here — everything under _plan/ and _records/, and records.jsonl — is internal and may change without notice; integrating against those paths is unsupported. Raw model responses live at the bedrock-inference run's own prefix; inspection_manifest.json's inference_runs[] is the join. Product paths are {run_prefix}/{asset_idx}/{basename}, one per (asset, category) in the request.

credits-read.description: Verbatim card text per nondiegetic block (end credits, main titles, logo runs, head slates), cards in display order with their programme-second timestamps — EVIDENCE only; which cards deserve voice is the consumer's judgment

lines: In Loving Memory of Our Friend

credits-read.notes: Cards come from dense selection over shot-segmentation's OWN frame archives (4 fps, embedding change-gate + 6 s heartbeat — the heartbeat is what keeps slow SCROLLS sampled). A line the model could not read is the literal string [UNREADABLE], never a guess. gaps[] lists spans whose read produced nothing usable, with reasons; partial success IS success and the semantic retry is a fresh idempotency_token.

title-read.description: Verbatim text of unreadable-text shots OUTSIDE the nondiegetic blocks — supers, location cards, chapter titles over picture

lines: Based on the book Love and Peace by Jordan Roe

title-read.notes: Auto-trigger is shots flagged unreadable_text_present by shot-metadata-enrichment; the trigger INHERITS that flag's recall (a super the per-shot pass never saw fires nothing — measured, mitj404 shot 371). Explicit spans are the override.

claim-verify.description: Adversarial verification of visual claims: per explicit span+question, a verdict from a CLOSED enum with cited visible evidence

verdicts.evidence: the person on the floor raises their head in the final two frames

claim-verify.notes: verdict is validated against supported|contradicted|indeterminate — an out-of-enum answer is a parse failure and lands in gaps[], never passed through. Spans are ALWAYS caller-explicit and each carries its question; the question is part of request identity (a new question is a new run, the same question absorbs).

manifest.description: Traceability by POINTER: the resolved spans and units, per-product locations and gap counts, and the bedrock-inference run entries
manifest.notes: inference_runs[].output_s3_prefix is the bedrock run: request.jsonl there is the EXACT rendered bytes (frames included), response.jsonl the raw model output per record (join by record_id {asset_idx}:{category}:{span_idx}:{chunk}), summary.json the authoritative outcome and cost. Raw responses are never copied into products.

usage.description: Aggregated spend for the run's (single, pooled) bedrock-inference submission, with the cost_is_complete discipline
usage.notes: Costs are estimates from bedrock-inference's own summaries; cost_is_complete=false means the run's summary lacked a figure.
